comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
7-item Memorial Album (added as of Chapter 3: Cetus) related to produced/looted items gained by defeating Cetus in the Sea of Wonders -- SOW1/Alexandria edition. It consists of the following items:

Cetus (color-customizable crest; awarded when you first defeat Cetus)
Flag of a Sea Monster
Sea Monster's Tusk
Phantom Paneling
Sea Monster's Hood
Sea Monster's Robe
Sea Monster's Evil Spear

Reward is Sea Monster's Ring from El Greco in Seville (accessory; gives Shipbuilding +2 .... !!!). Details are (mostly) on the item's respective pages. Cheers.

Source/pics: wittyship.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1179.html
